ops.oldText: Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: Vendor's sole remedy is simple interest on the overdue amount at the lesser of one percent per month or the maximum rate permitted by Applicable Law, accruing from the due date until payment.

input.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the liquidated damages of fifteen percent of annual Fees per week and replaced it with simple late-payment interest capped at one percent per month (or the legal maximum) as Vendor's sole remedy, because our playbook does not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer. The ten-day trigger and the dispute mechanics in Section 7.3 are unchanged.
input.summary: Replace Customer-payable liquidated damages in 7.7 with simple late-payment interest as Vendor's sole remedy; timing untouched.
